Courtney M. Cox — Hardwiring Hercules? (Arizona State Law Journal, 2026) · a twenty-minute two-host explainer

Courtney Cox argues that both sides of the debate over a right to a human decision have missed what normative uncertainty does to their best arguments. A judge who is genuinely unsure what she ought to do, and who responds to that uncertainty rationally, cannot give the aligned explanation that humanists demand of machines. But building a machine usually means hardwiring one jurisprudence, which forecloses that same rational response — so the machinists' promise of a merely better decision fails too. Her proposal is to stop asking who decides and start asking how much should be decided at once.
